name: [Portal] Requests (poptávky) data model (DB)
description:
### Summary

`partners_web`'s contract dedicates a whole resource group to `requests` (`/requests`, `/requests/{slug}`, `/requests/{slug}/messages`) — the "poptávky" marketplace where a visitor posts a request and partners react to it. Nothing in `st_crm` represents this; CZ3TDR1-572 only covered the professionals/categories side of the old WordPress site.

### Why?

Requests are a distinct public feature of partneri.shoptet.cz (its own archive, detail pages and a "Nová poptávka" form) with no equivalent anywhere in cms4 today.

### What?

New tables for a request post, its own category taxonomy (same `CategoryRef` shape as professionals/webinars but taxonomy `requests`), and the reaction/message a visitor sends about a request.

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `partner_request` (`id`, `slug` unique, `title`, `content`, `authorName`, `authorEmail` never exposed, `url` nullable, `isShoptet` bool, `shoptetId` nullable, `status` publish/expired, `solvingPartnerId` nullable FK → `partner.id`, `createdAt`)
- [ ] `partner_request_category` + `partner_request_category_lng` (mirrors `partner_category`/`partner_category_lng`: `name`, `title`, `slug` unique per language, `description`) + `partner_request_category_rel` (many-to-many; contract allows 1-3 categories per request)
- [ ] `partner_request_message` (`id`, `requestId` FK, `authorName`, `authorEmail` never exposed, `message`, `createdAt`) for the `/requests/{slug}/messages` reaction endpoint
- [ ] Migration under `migrations/2026/devrel/crm/CZ3TDR1-673/`, `make lint-migrations` passes

### Open questions

- Is `status` flipped publish→expired by a scheduled job (time-based) or manually in admin? Needed by the requests domain-layer task filed alongside this one — flag for DevRel to decide.

### Resources

- Epic: CZ3TDR1-614
- Depends on: CZ3TDR1-572 (`partner` table, for `solvingPartnerId`)

### Technical notes

_Generated by Claude Sonnet 5, 2026-09-22._ Source: `contract/openapi.yaml` `RequestSummary`/`Request`/`NewRequestBody`/`MessageBody` schemas. No existing "poptávka"/request table found anywhere in the monorepo.
